chapters.label: 01 / THE FORM
chapters.title: A star made of stars
chapters.body: The symbol {5/2, 3} means pentagram faces, with three meeting at each vertex.

chapters.label: 02 / ONE FACE
chapters.title: Follow the pentagram
chapters.body: The five-pointed star at right is a single face. Its crossings are not extra vertices.

chapters.label: 03 / THE COUNT
chapters.title: A familiar equation
chapters.body: 20 vertices - 30 edges + 12 faces = 2. The abstract surface satisfies Euler's formula.
